_source: Rendered (not hand-written) from pivota-backend services/catalog_trust_policy.derive_trust at commit d4f99ae90, over the matrix in tests/test_catalog_trust_policy_crawl_fresh.py (itertools.product of _PRODUCTS x _IDENTITIES x elected [None,True,False] x route [None,True,False] x priced [True,False], in that order).
